text: Wounded Highmountain Warriors are Highmountain tauren located on the Broken Shore.

The Wrath of Azshara is the last boss in Eye of Azshara. The Hatecoil created the Wrath of Azshara through the Tidestone of Golganneth after Parjesh's failure to repel the class orders. Lysande, one of Azshara's most loyal handmaidens so loved her Queen that she sacrificed herself to become vengeance incarnate, in order to protect her. Her frozen soul now resides within the Frozen Soul Pendant, an ancient amulet that was created by the Queen herself, and which offers tremendous power to those who channel the power of frost.
Wrathguard Servitors are wrathguard located at Highmountain Burial Ground in Highmountain.

The Wreck of the Sky Shark is all that remains of the Horde zeppelin, the Sky Shark, after it set sail from Orgrimmar to Pandaria. The zeppelin belonged to Rivett Clutchpop. The wreckage is strewn over a wide swath of land on the northwestern edge of the Jade Forest, debris falling from the steep cliffs and also landing in several small hozen villages. The Sky Shark set off from Orgrimmar under orders from to find his fleet of missing ships. Barely through the magical mists surrounding Pandaria, they were spotted by a passing Alliance ship. In the crossfire both vessels were destroyed. This is where Horde players begin their journey in Pandaria.

Wrath Lords are level 70 wrathguard found on the island of Socrethar's Seat in northwestern Netherstorm. They have a standard [https://www.wowhead.com/wotlk/spell=15496/cleave Cleave] ability. Link to Wowhead -- https://www.wowhead.com/wotlk/npc=20929/wrath-lord

The Wyrmcult or the Blackwing Coven and the Blackwing wyrmcultists, is a group of humans, orcs, Broken, and draenei that seem to worship the surviving members of the black dragonflight, most of which were killed off by the gronn after the destruction of Draenor. Their coven is located in Raven's Wood in the western part of the Blade's Edge Mountains. The Wyrmcult fells trees and hunts animals in the Ruuan Weald, much to the dislike of the druids in Evergrove — whom the Wyrmcultists are unwilling to negotiate with.

Wyrms' Bend is a pass in the Twilight Highlands that starts from Dragonmaw Pass at , ending at Grim Batol at . Two of the Dragonmaw Gates are locate here. During the Fourth War, the twilight dragonflight swarmed the area, fighting against the red dragonflight in the sky.

Wyrmrest Summit is the top of the dragonkin's sacred temple of Wyrmrest Temple. During the Dragon Soul instance the Summit had been already crippled by the assault of Deathwing and his minions. The Aspects and Thrall gathered to talk about how to empower the Dragon Soul here in order to use it against the Destroyer. In the meantime, the defenders of Wyrmrest went first into the Eye of Eternity to kill Hagara the Stormbinder to get the Focusing Iris. Afterwards they faced the greatest twilight dragon Deathwing ever created, the monstrosity known as Ultraxion, who tried to stop the Aspects and unleash the Hour of Twilight upon Azeroth.
Wyrmtongue Deathsearchers are located at the Highmountain Burial Ground in Highmountain.

Wu'de Prepfoot is a Highmountain tauren and member of the Prepfoot listening to the sermons of Trand Prepfoot at the Prepfoot Compound in Highmountain. He traveled to the Dragon Isles and got himself caught by the Worldbreakers. He is found in a Worldbreaker Cell in a cave at the Smoldering Perch in the Waking Shores.
Writs and Wordsmiths is an establishment located in Evermoon Commons of Suramar City in Suramar.
Wristwraps of Volatile Power drop from Shad'har the Insatiable in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Wyrm's Shadowflame Crest is used to upgrade Champion/Heroic Dragonflight Season 2 items from item levels 428–437. For more information, see the Flightstones article. Crests are also used as a reagent to make an Enchanted Wyrm's Shadowflame Crest, which will force crafted items to be in the item level 424–437 range. Obtain a crest by combining 15x Wyrm's Shadowflame Crest Fragment, which drop from Heroic Aberrus raid bosses and the end-of-run chest in a Mythic+ key in the 11–15 range. Additionally Vaskarn in Loamm can downgrade an Aspect's Shadowflame Crest down to a Wyrm's crest. Finally, Evantkis in front of the Great Vault of Valdrakken, will trade two Aspects' Token of Merit per crest.

Xavian is a satyr sect located in northeastern Ashenvale, living in the ruins of an ancient Night elf temple, north of Satyrnaar and west of Forest Song. The general Xalan the Feared was killed there by Sentinels and druids led by Shandris Feathermoon and Arvell. It is one of the three Ashenvale satyr settlements, the other two being Satyrnaar and Night Run. Of the three, Xavian seems to be the center of satyr political power in Ashenvale, as both Prince Raze and Geltharis live here. It is also the site of a dryad attack, and questing adventurers will find the mortally wounded Anilia, who searched for the stolen Branch of Cenarius, lying on the ground here. They're using Warsong Oil for thei
XT:4 is a shredder roaming Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Seereth Stonebreak wants XT:4 destroyed.
XT:9 is a shredder roaming Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Seereth Stonebreak wants XT:9 destroyed.

|thumb]] Xi'ri is a naaru located at the beginning of the path to the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley. Xi'ri was mentioned by Khadgar's Servant during the guided tour of Shattrath City, as the naaru who took the Sha'tar's war effort against Illidan Stormrage directly to the Betrayer's doorstep. In the final quest in the attunement chain, Xi'ri gives the Medallion of Karabor to the player after doing battle with Illidari demons, after a long quest chain involving Akama at the nearby Warden's Cage. During the final battle against Illidan, Xi'ri cast spells of protection on its allies.
Wyvern Tailspike dropped from Pridewing Patriarch which, prior to Cataclysm, could be found in the mountains east or south of Mirkfallon Lake in Stonetalon Mountains.

Wyvern riders, also called wind riders, are a type of windrider that consists of an orc or tauren mounted on a flying wyvern. The sentient wyverns of Kalimdor were eager to ally themselves with the shamanistic Horde. Impressed by the orcs' commitment to honor and victory, the wyverns allowed the orcs to ride them into combat against those who would disturb the tranquility of Kalimdor and its denizens. The wyverns, who share a common ancestry with both dragons and gryphons, use their powerful claws and razor-like fangs against both airborne attackers and ground troops, while their riders may hurl envenomed spears at the enemy.

Xarantaur is an elite tauren druid and quest giver at Camp Tunka'lo in the Storm Peaks. He is over ten thousand years old, having been among the first tauren druids to be tutored by Cenarius and raised to immortality by Nozdormu to serve as an agent of the bronze dragonflight. The Aspect gave him the Lorehammer.
Xerrath was a world destroyed by the Burning Legion as a show of power during the enslavement of Xoroth.

Xandros (in-game as Remains of Xandros) is a destroyed world in the Twisting Nether that players are sent to on the quest Destination: Unknown, part of the Talador storyline. Little information about the world is known other than that it was destroyed by Mongrethod, an annihilan of the Burning Legion.

Xandris the Dishonored is a satyr located at Moonclaw Vale in Val'sharah. He was among the first to betray his brethren and accept what later came to be referred to as the "curse of Xavius". During the War of the Ancients, Xandris slew many of Thaon Moonclaw's comrades and was last seen fleeing from Thaon when they encountered each other on the battlefield during that war.

Xalzaix is a merciless one that belonged to the C'Thrax known as Mythrax the Unraveler. Defeated by the snake loa Sethraliss, Mythrax was resurrected millennia later during the Fourth War. Channeling his power into Xalzaix, the faceless general destroyed the Great Seal at the heart of the great pyramid of Dazar'alor. He used it once more when confronted in Uldir, but was killed by brave adventurers.

The Xy'mox's Charity Cache was a charity esports tournament that was introduced on 31 August 2022 and took place on 10-11 September the same year. The event placed two guilds (Echo and Team Liquid) in a race to defeat select bosses from Castle Nathria and Sepulcher of the First Ones as quickly as possible to earn their respective charities a share of the $100,000 (USD) donation pool. However, there are a few twists and turns that Xy'mox prepared: *Instead of the usual Fated Power rotation, all bosses will have at least two Fated Powers activated. *Each raid will have two checkpoints which will grant an amount to donate to their charity, with a higher amount going to the guild that reaches th
A Yellow Power Crystal is a type of power crystal that can be found throughout the Screaming Reaches of Un'Goro Crater.
__NOTOC__ Yatheon is a blood elf engineering vendor located in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.

The Ymirjar were the elite warrior caste created by King Ymiron in service of the Lich King, the victorious vrykul in the battle of ascension at Jotunheim. They inhabit the city of Ymirheim in the center of Icecrown, which is of most significance to vrykul culture. During the war against the Lich King, the vrykul fought each other in the pit of Valhalas; the winners of these combats became one of their Ymirjar, while the loser became a cursed vargul, an undead creature. Had King Ymiron blown the horns and called for all of the leaders of the Ymirjar and mjordin alike, the vrykul would've become a force more powerful than any other within the Scourge. This action would've organized the vrykul

__NOTOC__ Yggdrel patrols west of the Dyvari Overgrowth and southeast of the Burial Fields in south-central . He is corrupted by fel magic. Unlike most rares and rare-elites in Shadowmoon Valley, Yggdrel hits incredibly hard and a group with a tank and a healer is encouraged, even at level . The Entangling Vine cannot be avoided.

Xyburn was a doomlord of the Burning Legion who participated in the War of the Ancients and made it his personal mission to eradicate the tauren race. The tauren hero and leader Huln Highmountain swore to kill him, and the two bitter foes finally clashed during the battle for the Well of Eternity near the end of the war. The fight ended only when Huln, seemingly beaten, landed a near-killing strike to Xyburn's face with his spear. The demon narrowly deflected the weapon, but since the spear was imbued with spirit powers it nonetheless struck Xyburn in the left eye, blinding him on that side. Huln won the battle, but before he could slay the doomlord, Xyburn was expelled back to the Twisting

Yogg-Saron's Flawless Plan was originally a humorous post on the official forums. It went like this: Yogg-Saron: Okay, so this whole plan is going pretty well. I've gunked up a tree in Grizzly Hills, I've enslaved the Keepers of Ulduar, and I've set up an impassable ravine between my inner sanctum and the outside world, so nobody can get in to stop me. Kologarn: AND I WILL STAND IN IT. Yogg-Saron: Seriously not necessary, K-Garn. I've got that whole thing under control. Check out the map. It says that's "The Shattered Walkway." It used to just be "The Walkway." Until I shattered it. No walkway, no progress. Pure effin' genius. Kologarn: AND THAT IS WHERE I WILL SQUEEZE THE LIFE OUT OF THEM.
Yel'Shir's Powerglove is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Xyraxz the Unknowable is a rare elite devourer controller located inside the Chamber of Wisdom of Korthia. Gain access to the chamber by using a Teleporter Repair Kit in the Ancient Teleporter at outside the Mauler's Outlook in central Korthia. The Conquering Korthia-required devourer drops ~21-25x Relic Fragment, 12x rare-quality anima items (175 anima), Xyraxz's Controlling Rod, Pauldrons of the Unknown Beyond, and the Obelisk of Dark Tidings (item), which starts another reliquary-recovery quest: Obelisk of Dark Tidings. Xyraxz also grants 5% progress for Shaping Fate. Xyraxz scales up to raid-boss levels of health, so bring a group including a tank and a healer!

__NOTOC__ Yarxhov the Pillager is a rare elite maw caster located inside the Chamber of Knowledge of Korthia. Gain access to the chamber by using a Teleporter Repair Kit in the Ancient Teleporter at outside the Estuary of Awakening in central Korthia. The Conquering Korthia-required pillager also drops ~21-38x Relic Fragment, 5-6x rare-quality anima items (175-210 anima), and the Everliving Statuette (item), which starts another relic-recovery quest: Everliving Statuette. It also drops Yarxhov's Rib-Cage for plate wearers, and Fallen Vault Guardian's Spire. Additionally, the rare is worth 5% progress toward Shaping Fate. __NOTOC__ .]] Yowler is a gnoll found in the Redridge Mountains. Magistrate Solomon wants Yowler's cold, dead paw. The Stormwind Army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect the Redridge Mountains from local threats like the gnolls. Their leader is Yowler, who resides within the Redridge Canyons and is wanted dead by the people of Lakeshire. Guard Parker notes that over a hundred gnolls called Yowler have been killed and that the original Yowler must have had a large number of sons with the same name as him. As it happens, yet another Yowler is threatening Lakeshire at this time.

__NOTOC__ .]] :"The Eye of the Storm must be seized for the Horde!" Yula the Fair was an elite blood elf Eye of the Storm battlemaster located in the Lower City in Shattrath City during the Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm.

Yulda the Stormspeaker is the leader of the frost vrykul in Valkyrion. Her village and the Brunnhildar Village hate each other because Yulda pledged allegiance to the Lich King and tried to convert other Hyldnir. She managed to escape Brunnhildar Village on the strength of her magic when they tried to kill her.

You Runed Everything! is a Legion raid achievement earned from defeating Odyn after gaining Runic Mastery on Normal difficulty or higher. When Draw Power begins in phase 2, runes on the floor light up in an order, and the incoming adds must be killed in the same order they lit up. Once this has been done, the 'Runic Mastery' debuff will appear, ensuring the achievement is earned once the fight has finished. It is best to pop Bloodlust/Heroism after the debuff appears to make sure Draw Power doesn't happen again.
Yuke Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Young Belvo is a giant sea turtle. It's used as a boat by the Iskaara Tuskarr to travel throughout Azeroth. Its route begins and ends at Iskaara in the Azure Span on the Dragon Isles, and journeys to the following locations: *Bloodmoon Isle, Grizzly Hills, Northrend *Isle of the Watchers, Azsuna, Broken Isles *Western Watch, Drustvar, Kul Tiras *Abyssal Breach, Vashj'ir, Eastern Kingdoms *Shatterstone Harbor, Vol'dun, Zandalar *Isle of Reckoning, Kun-Lai Summit, Pandaria *Bay of Storms, Azshara, Kalimdor

The Zandalar Illusionist's Wraps are cloth wristguards for mages which gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, spirit, and overall magical power. The wraps are part of the armor set called the Illusionist's Attire.

__NOTOC__ Zalene Firstlight is a blood elf food and drink vendor located at Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods. She is the only source for Springpaw Appetizers, needed for The Party Never Ends. Unlike other NPCs in the area, she is not affiliated with Silvermoon City and will not provide faction discount.

__NOTOC__ Zaedana is a blood elf mage trainer located in Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon City. By the time of the Fourth War, she was promoted to the rank of Magister. She was encountered in the Ruins of Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh by Alliance champions. She was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.
__NOTOC__ Zalle is a blood elf reagent vendor located in General Goods in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

The Zandalar Tribe was a faction of Zandalari trolls, active on Yojamba Isle with the release of Zul'Gurub. They came to Yojamba Isle in an effort to recruit help against the resurrected Blood God and his Atal'ai priests in Zul'Gurub and the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. With the Gurubashi trolls destroyed and the Blood God no longer an issue, most Zandalari trolls have returned back to their homeland Zandalar, leaving Yojamba Isle empty. Exalted reputation with this faction was made a Feat of Strength.

Zak'rajan the Undying is the spectre of a long-dead Zandalari ruler who controls the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun. Long ago, he enticed trolls into following him by promising them wealth beyond measure. However, he rejected kings and forbade his followers from worshipping the loa; only Zak'rajan was to be honored. At some point he betrayed his followers and imprisoned their souls in powerful golems. For countless ages, he has enslaved the souls, wielding them as weapons and using them to power the golems guarding his court. The death loa Bwonsamdi refused to let the spirits permanently die or allow them into his realm, the Other Side. Zak'rajan is found in his throne room at the top of the

The Zan-Tien mogu are one of the clans that rose to power following the defeat of Lei Shen, warring against the Baruk and Dokani for control over the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. They are known for their command over cloud serpents and storm magic and are considered by many to be the dominant mogu clan, though the other clans surely disagree. After N'Zoth was freed from its prison, the Baruk, Dokani, and Zan-Tien took advantage of the chaos to invade the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and fight each other for control. The Zan-Tien amassed outside the Golden Pagoda and posed the most direct threat to the Golden Lotus. They trapped some Rajani Warserpents in serpent cages at the Golden Stair.

Z'rali is a naaru who participated in a battle in Revendreth that took place in Sinfall, which was once a place of dark magic and experimentation for Sire Denathrius. An affront upon the Light was committed there, and Z'rali and the Light's forces retaliated, seeking justice. They scorched the Ember Ward, blighting it with holy magic, but its walls still stand. She was defeated and laid broken on the battlefield until she was found by the unseen ones who preserved her to serve as a vessel for Denathrius' rage. She cannot return to her home because the other naaru would only consider her an aberration due to being tainted by what Denathrius did to her. She was held prisoner in the Sanguine De
Zane Bradford is a Forsaken wand vendor located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
Zarise is a Forsaken flight master located at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. During the Legion Invasions of Hillsbrad, she announced the reinforcements from Undercity.

The naga sorceress Zar'jira, known to the Darkspear tribe as the Sea Witch, was a supposed goddess that the Underworld Minions, including a band of murlocs, worshiped on the Darkspear islands in the Maelstrom until Thrall destroyed their cavern of worship. The murlocs' leader, the murloc sorcerer, referred to her as "the exalted one".

__NOTOC__ Zandine is a blood elf hunter trainer located in the Rangers' Lodge in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City. She also directs hunters to Ormak Grimshot for questing. She was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

__NOTOC__ Zanien is a blood elf warlock trainer located in The Sanctum in Murder Row in Silvermoon City. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he was encountered by the champions of the Council of the Black Harvest in Dalaran. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

__NOTOC__ Zanzil Zombies can be found in Cape of Stranglethorn. These zombies were created by Zanzil the Outcast using a special mixture made from jungle plants. The mixture gives them augmented strength and durability at the expense of their mental faculties. The zombies now live in the ruins around Zanzil and protect him, attacking travelers on sight.
Zaralash is a dracthyr located just inside the Trade District in Stormwind City. She is found speaking with a Stormwind City Guard.

A zeppelin tower is usually a multi-story building where a zeppelin docks to pickup and drop off passengers. These buildings mark regular routes and usually have Horde guards at its entrances and docking platforms — as the zeppelin is the primary intercontinental transportation for the Horde. Presently, there are seven zeppelin towers: *Two stone towers between Brill and the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades. *Docking platform jutting out of the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. *Zeppelin landing in Grom'gol Base Camp, Stranglethorn Vale. * Forsaken tower in Vengeance Landing, Howling Fjord. * Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra — the zeppelin actually docks within Warsong Hold itself. *Two zeppelin towers

Zeth'kur was an orcish port town that existed before the shattering of Draenor. It was located on Hellfire Peninsula's southeastern area, just south of the Dark Portal. During the Invasion of Draenor, the shipyards of Zeth'kur and the warships stationed there were all destroyed by the Alliance Expedition forces in order to establish a fleet and attack the surrounding orcish clans.
__NOTOC__ Zelan is a blood elf mining vendor located in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.

__NOTOC__ Zephyr, called Zeph by Cupri, is a Keepers of Time representative, in high elf guise, located in the World's End Tavern of Shattrath City. She offers a teleport to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris to players with Keepers of Time reputation. She seems to enjoy the occasional beverage while at the Tavern. According to Cupri, Zephyr has continued to investigate in Shattrath even after the events of The Burning Crusade.

Zen'Aliri is a jungle troll druid training with Garl Stormclaw under Ithis Moonwarden. Zen'Aliri hopes to one day join the Druids of the Talon. For the time being, he is stationed at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater. Many years later, Zen'Aliri traveled to Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains on the Dragon Isles and is seen at Greenscale Inn, together with Hamuul and Bashana Runetotem. After the Primalists claimed the portal to the Emerald Dream on the Ancient Bough, he aided the green dragonflight in reclaiming it.

An item collection. This is not a true set; there are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all of this set. It drops from the Argus rare spawns and the various chests around the planet. It looks like the armor worn by Burning Legion enforcers on the planet such as antaen.

Zul'Dare (or Zul'dare) is an island that belongs to the nation of Kul Tiras. It is part of the region of the Channel Islands and is located either south or southeast of the peninsula of Gilneas, in Baradin Bay. Zul'Dare has not been introduced in World of Warcraft, and its status is unknown.

Zirion was a bronze drake sent, along with 11 other bronze dragons, through the timeways by the bronze aspect Nozdormu. No matter where he and the others attempted to journey in history, they always emerged at the same point in the future, the Hour of Twilight, and it was there he was nearly killed by the leader of the Infinite dragonflight, Murozond. He was able to meet up with Nozdormu and Tick. While dying Zirion uses the last of his strength to look away from the Timeless One with a look of terror in his eyes.
Zillane is a jungle troll flight master located at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Zian of the Endless Shadow was an emperor of the mogu empire. He was a powerful sorcerer who kept the kingdoms in check through terror and darkness. He used the Lantern of the Sorcerer King to fuel his most powerful spells. His spirit appears in Mogu'shan Vaults as part of the Spirit Kings encounter.
Ziggie Sparks is a goblin quest giver located on the Darkmoon Island.
The Zombie Masters are powerful zombies that roam the Ruins of Lordaeron during The Flight from Lordaeron.

Zuluhed's Key drops from Zuluhed the Whacked at Dragonmaw Fortress in Shadowmoon Valley. The key is used to free Karynaku from the chains binding her. The key is consumed on use, but in a quest group some players may still retain the key after completing the quest. In those cases, the key serves no further purpose, and can be manually destroyed.

"Swift" Kit is sold by Gamesmaster Fleurian in Silvermoon City for 20 Illusionary Coin, which can be earned by playing Decor Duels. This kit is used to unlock the Swift (Spellbreaker) passive buff for the Spellbreaker seekers.

"Arcane Ranger" Kit would likely have been sold by Gamesmaster Fleurian in Silvermoon City for Illusionary Coin, which can be earned by playing Decor Duels. The item was however never made available, and the class was instead immediately available.

The 2nd Battalion is a military force of the Stormwind Army. After reports of Shadowhide gnoll activity in the northeast and heavy Blackrock activity in the east, the Stormwind Guard in Redridge Mountains expected reinforcements from Stormwind City. Due to the manipulations of Lady Katranar Priestor, however, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon couldn't deploy the 2nd Battalion and instead deputized Alliance adventurers to assist them.

"A Whisper of Warning" is a short story by Delilah Dawson published digitally on the official site on 6 May 2024. It is also part of the anthology The Voices Within. It is illustrated by Ognjen Sporin. After her visit in Dalaran at the end of , Alleria Windrunner prepares to go out on a mission to hunt down the Dark Heart and the mysterious Harbinger. Before that, she makes a stop in Silvermoon City.

This often makes betas a very exciting time to be playing a game, with testers able to experience new features and explore new content months ahead of other players. As well as providing an advanced preview of the game as it will be released, betas typically see extensive changes and developments, often including repeated iterations of major features, reworking and remodeling of zones and instances, and myriad tweaks and adjustments to player abilities. Arrowflight was a white quel'dorei mare steed and the mount of Lireesa Windrunner before the Great Wars, gifted by King Anasterian. At the onset of the Second War, Verath and Lireesa were sent to Lordaeron City, so they set out on their horses. On their way, however, they were ambushed by the Amani trolls and orcs of the Old Horde south of Northwatch Tower in Eastweald. While the elves died, the horses managed to escape and returned home to Windrunner Spire. Her status afterward is unknown.

Assisted Highlight is an accessibility feature introduced in patch 11.1.7 that offers real-time visual guidance by highlighting the next suggested damage-dealing ability during combat, aiming to support player orientation and ease of use. It is intended to support new players, returning players, or those experimenting with unfamiliar classes and specializations. When enabled, it highlights the next suggested offensive ability based on the player's current resources, cooldowns, and combat context. There is also a daily quest from Challenger Soong or Challenger Wuli providing 3 fragments.
